liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Little Red Rooster** (2 reviews): Brent's lead playing on Rooster is praised as jamming; Little Red Rooster was hot [15][25]
- **Promised Land** (1 review): Promised Land is missing from the video release; the reviewer wondered why Bertha into Cold Rain opened [19]
- **When I Paint My Masterpiece** (1 review): Brent sings with great force on Masterpiece [16]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Bird Song was played very nicely [15]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Reviewer found the Uncle John's Band a mess [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-12-31.140070.sbd.pcm.miller.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 29 songs; 235 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd87-12-31.sbd.ashley.402.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 162 min; rated 4.12/5 by 8 [2]. Said about its sound: Levels are good and the mix excellent, with slight background noise in the left channel [21]
- **gd1987-12-31.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.85684.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 171 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd1987-12-31.164120.ultramatrix.walker.scotton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: soundboard; 24 songs; 170 min [4]
- **gd87-12-31.sbd.patched.etter.23040.sbefail.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 22 songs; 159 min; rated 4.27/5 by 11 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer thinks it is a pre-FM source, sounding richer than other soundboards and matching a tape they once owned; Sound is described as very good; Levels are good and the mix excellent, with slight background noise in the left channel [14][16][22]

## Around the show

- The encore with the Neville Brothers is singled out as a reason to download [14]
- One attendee pictured Jerry as Santa and Mickey Hart as Spock [18]
- The DVD release omits Promised Land and the Neville encores, except Knockin' [19]
- On the pay-per-view broadcast, Kesey called Danny Ainge a mean Mormon [20]
- Reviewer's first bootleg tape of this show was mislabeled as Pittsburgh 87 [23]
- Reviewer watched the pay-per-view broadcast and taped the whole thing on video [25]
- Neville Brothers members joined for Man Smart, Iko Iko, Banana Boat Song, and Do You Wanna Dance [1]
- The Neville Brothers played on the last four songs [3]
- Uncle John's Band repeats a performance from the same run of shows [19]
- Reviewer finds the second set starts fine but slopes off, while the first set is a favorite [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-12-31.140070.sbd.pcm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Broadcast Mix > PCM (clone off Sony F1 Master) [1]. Also: The show was released commercially on video as Ticket To New Year's [1]
- **gd87-12-31.sbd.ashley.402.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> FM> REEL (TandbergTD20ASE)> WAV> SHN [2]
- **gd1987-12-31.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.85684.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) D [3]. Also: Source chain is FM to master reel to CD supplies, from tapes by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; A patch source was recorded by Jay Ashley [3]
- **gd1987-12-31.164120.ultramatrix.walker.scotton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Joani Walker; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller, Paul Scotton; source: Joani Walker's Master Ultramatrix Soundboard Cassettes (TDK MA-XG90) [4]
- **gd87-12-31.sbd.patched.etter.23040.sbefail.shnf**: source: bootleg disc of unknown source (pre-FM?) -- Sound: A+ Secondary source: Jay Ashley's FM reel -- SBD>>FM>>REEL(TandbergTD20ASE)>>WAV>>SHN -- Sound A- see… [7]. Also: Reviewer originally taped the show off the radio in the late 1980s; the tapes were later stolen from their car [16]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1987-12-31 Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-12-31-oakland-alameda-county-coliseum-oakland-ca-usa/) [27]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1987-12-31 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1987-12-31-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [28]
